summary: Tracking & Progress Feature Testing Complete - Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%), Frontend: All features verified. Home screen 'Mein Fortschritt' button navigates to /tracking. Without profile: shows 'Gesundheits-Check erforderlich' message with CTA. With profile: shows full dashboard with progress stats, streak, compliance rate, insights card, symptom tracker (1-10 ratings), compliance tracker (supplement checklist), trend charts, and milestones.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend progress.py correctly implements all tracking endpoints with proper Pydantic validation
tracking_engine.py implements sophisticated trend analysis, milestone detection, and intelligent insights generation
Frontend tracking.tsx correctly fetches dashboard data from API and displays all components
SymptomTracker.tsx provides 1-10 rating inputs for overall and 5 categories (energy, sleep, mood, concentration, digestion)
ComplianceTracker.tsx shows supplements from user's plan with interactive checkboxes
ProgressHeader.tsx displays streak, progress %, days tracked, and compliance rate
InsightsCard.tsx shows coach messages with type-based color coding (positive, warning, suggestion, info, motivation)
MilestonesCard.tsx displays achieved milestones with icons
data-testid attributes present on all interactive elements for testing
seed_data_creation: Profile has 5 days of symptom and compliance data (2026-01-15 to 2026-02-28)
context_for_next_testing_agent: TRACKING FEATURE FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Key routes: /tracking (progress dashboard). AsyncStorage key: 'health_profile_id'. Backend endpoints: GET /api/tracking/dashboard/{profile_id}?lang=de (returns progress, streak, days_tracked, symptom_trend, symptom_chart, overall_chart, compliance_rate, compliance_daily, compliance_trend, milestones, insights), POST /api/tracking/symptoms (saves symptom ratings), POST /api/tracking/compliance (saves supplement compliance), GET /api/tracking/symptoms/{profile_id} (history), GET /api/tracking/compliance/{profile_id} (history). Frontend components: SymptomTracker, ComplianceTracker, ProgressHeader, InsightsCard, MilestonesCard. Trend calculation: compare first vs second half averages. Milestones: 3/7/14/30 day streaks, 80%/90% compliance, first day/week/month. Insights: dynamic coach messages based on tracking data.
